attempts.summary: Blacklisted usb-storage on node1 (RHEL7, kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7) via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf using both `blacklist` and `install ... /bin/true` directives, rebuilt the initramfs with dracut so the block applies at early boot, and confirmed the module cannot be loaded now or after a reboot. Completed the mandatory single-node restart/recovery protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued a native reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until SSH exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed (fresh uptime), and verified sshd was active and the module stayed unloaded (including after an explicit post-reboot modprobe attempt) with the blacklist file intact.
